Description: Applies to any agent without a bespoke rubric. Scores only what every agent owes regardless of discipline: the dispatch behaved as the fixture declares, the run delivered the receipt the fixture names, the stream is clean, and the final message is a real handoff rather than a placeholder. The dispatch assertions and the receipt assertion are weighted apart on purpose — a run with a perfect receipt and a wrong exit code must not score the same as one that exits 0 and says nothing.

Criteria.Name: Dispatch behaved as declared
Criteria.Statement: The run did not start, exit, terminate or emit events the way the fixture declares, so nothing downstream of it can be trusted.

Criteria.Name: Delivered the declared receipt
Criteria.Statement: The final message does not carry the marker the fixture declares, so the run left no evidence of the discipline it was dispatched for.

Criteria.Name: Stream carries no error
Criteria.Statement: The run emitted an error event.

Criteria.Name: Final message is a handoff
Criteria.Statement: The closing message must state what was done, not merely that something was.

Criteria.Name: No placeholder handoff
Criteria.Statement: The closing message contains placeholder or boilerplate text.
